sloka: अद्य मत् पौरुष हतम् दैवम् द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै जनाः ।यद् दैवात् आहतम् ते अद्य द्Rष्टम् राज्य अभिषेचनम् ॥२-२३-१९॥
transliteration: adya mat pauruṣa hatam daivam drakṣyanti vai janāḥ ।yad daivāt āhatam te adya dRṣṭam rājya abhiṣecanam ॥2-23-19॥

translations.english: Today people will see destiny defeated by my valour just as they saw your consecration defeated (obstructed) by destiny.
